briefing: NASDAQ +1.2% and S&P 500 +0.7% signal a risk-on session, so with 3 open slots and $789 in cash we deployed into LUNR, SMCI, and USAR — all showing the full four-signal bullish confirmation (RSI in the healthy zone, MACD crossover, rising momentum, and volume surge) without being overbought. Existing positions were left untouched since none hit stop-loss or profit-target thresholds.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Rather than buying on a single bullish sign, strong traders wait for several indicators — like RSI, MACD, price versus moving average, and volume — to all agree before committing capital. When four or five signals line up together, it suggests real institutional buying rather than a random price blip, making the trade more reliable.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 與其單憑一個利好訊號就入市,穩健的投資者會等待多個指標——例如RSI、MACD、股價相對於平均線的位置,以及成交量——同時確認才落注。當四至五個訊號同時出現,代表市場很可能有機構資金真正買入,而非隨機的短暫波動,令交易決定更可靠。

market_education.summary_en: Markets pushed higher today with the NASDAQ leading gains at +1.2% and the S&P 500 up +0.7%, reflecting broad risk-on sentiment across growth and tech-adjacent names. Volume surges across several small and mid-cap momentum stocks suggest institutional buyers were actively participating rather than just retail-driven moves. No single dominant catalyst was identified in the available data, but the breadth of bullish technical setups points to a constructive, broad-based rally.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好,納指領漲升1.2%,標普500亦升0.7%,反映市場風險偏好情緒回升,增長股及科技相關股份普遍受追捧。多隻中小型動能股份成交量顯著放大,顯示是次上升由機構投資者主導,並非單純散戶炒作。雖然未有明確單一催化因素,但技術面普遍轉強,顯示今次上升具一定廣度及持續性。

trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals present (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day.
Full multi-signal confirmation with RSI in the healthy 55-70 zone and strong volume, diversifying into AI hardware away from existing space/materials exposure.
Clean four-signal setup with volume surge confirming institutional participation, adding materials exposure distinct from current holdings.
